content: Nuni ammanon minnidayti hankko ammanon minnonttayta meto tookkanaas bessees attiin nu xalla ufayettizayta gidanaas bessenna.
Nuni wurikka hara asi ba ammanon minnana mala iza go7izaazinne ufayssiza miish ane ooththoos.
Kirstoosi bana ufayssibeenna; harappeka, «Asay nena cayida cashshay tana gakkides» geetetti kase Geeshsha Maxaafan xaafettidayssi polettides.
Nuni Geeshsha Maxaafatappe demmiza dandayaynne minoteththi nuus daana mala koyroppe xaafettidayssi wurikka nu izappe nuus timirte demmana mala xaafettides.
Minoteththinne dandaya immiza Xoossi intte Yesus Kirstoosa kaallishin inttes intte giddon Ayana issifeteth immo.
Hessika intte issi wozinaninne issi doona gididi nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Aawaa Xoossa bonchchanaassa.
Ammanontta Deretas Sabbakettida Mishiraachcho Qaala
Hessa gishshas Xoossi inttena Xoossa bonchchon mokki ekkida mala intteka issoy issaa ufayssan mokki ekkite.
Kase aawatas imettida hidota qaalaa polanaas Xoossa tumateththi erettana mala Kirstoosi Ayhudatas ooththizaade gididayssa ta inttes yootays.
Hessaththoka Ayzaabeti iza maaroteththaa gishshas Xoos galatana mala; hessika,
geetetti Geeshsha Maxaafan xaafettida mala.
Qasseka, «Ayzaabetoo!
geetetti Geeshsha Maxaafan xaafettides.
Nam7anththoka, «Ayzaabeti
geetetti Geeshsha Maxaafan xaafettides.
Hessaththo Isayaasan,
Intte izan ammaniza gishshas hidota Xoossi inttenan ufayssinne saroteth kunththo; hessika Xillo Ayana wolqqa hidotay inttes daranaassa.
Ayzaabeta Oosanchcha Phawuloosa
Ta ishatoo! Intte lo7eteththan, erateth ubbaan kumidaytanne harata zoranaas eray dizayta gididayssa ta addafe shaakka eradis.
Ta Xoossafe ekkida imotaa gina qasseka inttena qofsanaas issi issi yo7ota xalateththan inttes xaafadis.

Hessa he kiyateththi imettiday tani Xoossa Mishiraachcho qaalaa hankko deretas yootana malassa; qasseka qeese mala gidida Yesus Kirstoosas ooththanaassa; hessa gishshas hankko dere asay Xillo Ayanan dummatidi Xoos ufayssiza yarsho gididi shiiqana mala ooththays.
Hessa tani Xoossas ooththiza gishshas Yesus Kirstoosan ceeqettays.
Ta yootidayssaninne ta ooththidayssan hankko dere asay Xoossas azazettana mala Kirstoosi tanan gididi ooththidaazappe attiin hara haasayana xalikke.
Hessika haniday Xillo Ayana wolqqan malaatata baggara hanides; hessa malankka Yerusalaameppe Ilwaqoore gakkanaas ta Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho qaalaa sabbakadis.
Hara asi kase ooththidason ta gelontta mala gaada kase Kirstoosa sunththi xeygetti eronttason Mishiraachcho qaalaa sabbakanayssi taas amo.
Harappeka,
geetetti kase Geeshsha Maxaafan xaafettida mala hanides.
Hessa gaason ta intteko bontta mala daro wode digettadis.
Oroome Beyanaas Phawuloosa Giigeteth
Ha7i qasse taas haan oosoy baynda gishshas daro layththatappe haa simmiin inttena beyanaas ta daro laamotadis.
Hayssa ta qofaa tani Ispeene biza wode polanaas qoppays; heera aadhdhashe inttena beyanaassinne inttenara guuththa wode gam7ada laamota aaththida mala intte tana maaddana gaada hidota ooththays.
Ha7i qasse ammanizaytas imettiza maado miish ekkada Yerusalaame bays.
Gaasoykka Maqidooniyaninne Akayan diza manqota maaddana Xoossa derey dendides.
Hayssa ha maadoza istti ba dosan immiday istti ooththanaas bessiza gishshassa; Ayzaabeti Ayhudatara issife Ayana anjjo ekkizayta gidikko isttika baas diza biittaa anjjon Ayhudata maaddanaas bessees.
Hessa gishshas hayssa shiiqida maado miishshaa Yerusalaamen immidaappe guye intte achchara ta Ispeene baana.
Ta hee intteko bashe inttes Kirstoosa anjjo kunththa ekka baanayssa ta erays.
Ta ishatoo! Tani Xoossa woosan baaxetiza mala intteka tanara baaxetana mala ta inttena Godaa Yesus Kirstoosaninne Xillo Ayana siiqon woossays.
Tani Yuhudan diza ammanontta asaa kusheppe attana malanne Yerusalaamen diza ta oosoykka heen ammanizayta achchan ekettana mala taas woossite.
Hessika Xoossa shene mala hee intteko ta ufayssara baana malanne inttenara issife shempanaassa.
Saroteththa Goday inttenara ubbatara gido. Amiin.
